en.About.SupportText:
WhaleGenie is a completely free open-source project.

If you find it useful, you can use the payment codes below to support the developer.
en.Add.Backoff.Jitter: Half to one and a half times, at random
en.Add.CaptureKeyHint: Click, then press that key on the keyboard; it fills this field. Click again to cancel. A combination belongs in the Hotkey action.
en.Add.ColourPointEmpty: A pattern needs at least one colour beside the base one. Until there is one, this step cannot run: it would be looking for the base colour on its own.
en.Add.Exec.AskWarn: A macro started by a trigger has nobody beside it: the question waits indefinitely. Do not pick this for a step that runs unattended.
en.Add.FieldTakesFormula: This field accepts an expression; the expression is evaluated when the macro runs.
en.Add.ImageEmpty: No picture yet: a search with an empty list has nothing to look for.
en.Add.KeyRunEmpty: The run has no presses yet.
en.Add.NarrowLookHint: Counts what the page holds with this condition and the ones above it, and outlines the element the step would act on. Nothing is clicked.
en.Add.NoActionFound: Nothing in the catalogue matches that.
en.Add.OnError.AskUser: Ask me: retry, skip or stop
en.Add.OnError.Continue: Carry on with the next step
en.Add.OnError.NextIteration: Skip to the next loop round
en.Add.OpenKeyPadHint: Click the key on a keyboard laid out on screen.
en.Add.PickRegionHint: Drag a rectangle on the screen to fill these fields. F1 takes it; Esc cancels.
en.Add.ReturnPickHint: Ticked results each become a variable; hover a result to see what it holds
en.Add.SearchAction: Search: keys, names, or what an action does
en.Add.SelectHint: This window has no action yet: close it and drop a card from the library where the step should go.
en.Add.StepCommentPlaceholder: A note shown under the step in the list
en.Add.StepIdHint: The name this step goes by, written into the macro file. A result variable carries it and a condition points at the step with it.
en.Add.Title: Add Action
en.Add.ValueHint: Pick a variable for this cell, or work it out with a function.
en.Editor.AddBranchHint: Adds the next branch to this switch and opens its values for typing. A switch tries its branches from the top down and runs the first one that matches.
en.Editor.DeleteSubMacroMessage: Delete the submacro '{0}'? This cannot be undone.
en.Editor.DescriptionPlaceholder: What this callable macro does; this is shown when it is picked.
en.Editor.DragActionHint: Click an action to select it, then press Add step; double-click it to add it to the end of the list. A section's Add button places it inside that block.
en.Editor.EmptyBranchList: No branch yet. Use Add branch below.
en.Editor.GroupPlaceholder: Optional; a name that files this macro with others like it
en.Editor.HotstringEndCharsHint: A highlighted character button ends the abbreviation; click it again to turn it off. Space, Enter and Tab are stored as the characters themselves.
en.Editor.HotstringHint: Type up to 40 literal keyboard characters. Chinese input-method text is not part of a hotstring.
en.Editor.InputLimitHint: Events per second (KPS) this macro may send; 0 is no limit, range 0–999.
en.Editor.InterfaceHotkeySupport: Supports letters, digits, F1–F24, arrows, editing keys, numeric-keypad keys, and modifier combinations.
en.Editor.ManageGlobalsHint: Create, edit or remove the global variables this project shares.
en.Editor.ManageLocalsHint: Create, edit or remove the variables this macro keeps for itself, and rename the ones its steps write.
en.Editor.NamePlaceholder: Enter a name for your macro..
en.Editor.NoDocumentHint: Open a macro from the Macros page, or create a new one here.
en.Editor.NoStepsHint: Pick an action in the library and press Add step.
en.Editor.NoTriggerSelected: Select an entry to edit its condition.
en.Editor.PickActionHint: Pick an action in the library first
en.Editor.PickColor: Pick a color from the screen
en.Editor.PickSubMacro: Choose a project macro to copy
en.Editor.Problem.CannotSave: The macro has problems that must be fixed before saving.
en.Editor.ProcessNameHint: notepad, or chrome; the .exe is not needed
en.Editor.Project.NotWritten: Saved to the project; the project file has not been written yet.
en.Editor.Project.WriteFailed: The project file could not be written.
en.Editor.PublicMacroHint: Public macros have no trigger of their own. Adding one makes it a sub-macro of this macro and leaves a call step in the root list.
en.Editor.RecordEmpty: The recording caught nothing, which usually means nothing was done while it ran. Note that the system marks input sent by another program (a remote session, a virtual machine, an automation tool) as injected, and that input is left out on purpose so a macro never records its own playback. If you are working through a remote connection, turn off "Ignore Other Programs' Input" in the Record Actions panel and try again.
en.Editor.SpecificHint: These belong to this macro alone: its own input limit, the key that arms it, and the interface its callers read.
en.Editor.StepIdHint: Step name {0}: a result variable and a condition point at this step by it.
en.Editor.ToggleKeyHint: Press it once to disarm this macro, again to arm it. The key itself sends nothing, and it keeps working while the macro is disarmed.
en.Editor.UnsavedBlockedTitle: This macro cannot be saved yet
en.Editor.UnsavedMessageNamed: The macro '{0}' has changes that are not saved yet.
en.Export.Hint: Tick what goes into the file. A ticked macro takes its own submacros with it; a submacro ticked on its own leaves as a macro of its own.
en.Export.Title: Export macros
en.Expr.Op.Group: Put part of the expression in brackets
en.ExprBuilder.FunctionsFilter: Filter by name or by how it is written
en.GlobalConflict.Hint: These names are declared in the file and in this project. Renaming changes only the macros that came with the file; the project's own macros keep reading what they read.
en.GlobalConflict.Title: Global variables in both places
en.GlobalVariables.Help: These declarations are shared by every macro in the project. Changes are written into this document's draft and reach the project when the document is saved.
en.GlobalVariables.Name: Name
en.GlobalVariables.NoVariables: This project has no global variables yet.
en.GlobalVariables.Title: Global variables
en.HotstringKeyboard.Hint: Click keys to append literal characters. Space, Tab and Enter are stored as real characters.
en.HotstringKeyboard.Title: Typed-string keyboard
en.Import.Hint: Tick what is to come in. A macro brings the submacros written inside it; submacros ticked on their own go to the public library, where a project can take a copy of one.
en.Import.Title: Import macros
en.Import.ToLibrary: They will be added to the public library.
en.Import.ToProject: They will be added to this project.
en.Library.Empty: The public macro library is empty. Open a macro and publish it to the library from its settings.
en.Library.Heading: Public macro library
en.Library.Intro: Callable macros shared by every project. They have no trigger of their own; use one by copying it into a macro as a sub-macro.
en.Library.UseFailed: The public macro could not be inserted into the editor.
en.LocalVariables.Empty: This macro has no variables of its own yet. Use New variable to declare one.
en.LocalVariables.Hint: What this macro keeps for itself, in two kinds. A declared value is created here and given the value every run starts at; a name a step wrote exists because that step wrote it, so only its name changes here. Nothing is applied until Save.
en.LocalVariables.InitialPlaceholder: A value, or an expression such as count + 1
en.LocalVariables.StepHint: This name is written by a step, so what it holds is that step's to decide. Only the name is edited here.
en.LocalVariables.Title: Local variables
en.Look.Title: What the step saw
en.MacroInterface.Name: Name
en.Main.AboutText:
A little assistant DeepSeek helped write, which is why it is called WhaleGenie.

Turn keyboard, mouse, screen and window actions into step-by-step macros, and start them with a hotkey, a mouse button, the wheel, or the colour of a pixel on the screen.

This program is licensed under AGPL-3.0; the full text is LICENSE.txt beside the program, and the copyright notice is NOTICE beside it.

Version {0}
Icon: the pixel-art whale emoji by Emojiall, under CC BY 4.0, scaled and modified.
en.Main.CloseAllMessage: Remove every macro from the list? The project file is kept and will be saved as an empty list.
en.Main.EmptyHint: Use Add New Macro below to build your first macro.
en.Main.NoMatch: No macro matches what you typed.
en.Main.Title: WhaleGenie
en.Mcp.GrantsNote: Saved as you flip them, and read by a running server before every call: the client obeys a change on its next call, with no restart and no need to copy the block again. Reading the screen, the windows and their controls needs no grant.
en.Mcp.Intro: A client starts this program and talks to it over its own stdin and stdout. Choose the two permissions, then paste this block into that client's configuration.
en.Mcp.Run: Allow the AI to run macros
en.Mcp.Title: MCP
en.Menu.AddCell: Add a macro to this cell
en.Menu.AddCellIcon: Add a macro and choose its icon
en.Menu.Pin: Keep the menu open when another window is clicked
en.Menu.Unpin: Close the menu when another window is clicked
en.Palette.Edit: Edit the selected step (F2 or double-click)
en.Palette.Group: Group the selected steps into one step that runs them in order (Ctrl + G)
en.Palette.LiftToMacro: Lift the selected steps into a macro of their own: the values they read become its arguments, a call to it takes their place
en.Palette.MoveDown: Move the selected steps down (Ctrl + Down)
en.Palette.MoveUp: Move the selected steps up (Ctrl + Up)
en.Palette.NoPublicMacros: The public macro library is empty.
en.Palette.NoSubMacros: This macro has no submacros yet. Make one from the steps you want to use twice.
en.Palette.Paste: Paste below the selected step (Ctrl + V)
en.Palette.Redo: Redo the change that was undone (Ctrl + Y)
en.Palette.ToggleEnabled: Turn the selected steps on or off (Ctrl + E)
en.Run.OpenLook: See what this step looked at
en.Run.Title: Run and Debug
en.Run.TriggersHint: One line for each armed trigger that something looks at on a clock: what it waits for, whether that is true right now, when it was last looked at and when it will be looked at again. When a window is watched, the machine also says when one changes.
en.Settings.AutoSaveProjectNote: Changes are written back to the project file as they happen. A first start uses the default project; a project with no file is asked where to save when the program closes.
en.Settings.DriverAttachAtStart: Put virtual devices on at startup
en.Settings.FramesCardNote: How often, and whether it is reused
en.Settings.LoadLastProject: Open the last project at start
en.Settings.MenuLauncherHint: One keyboard shortcut, the middle or a side button; the wheel pages.
en.Settings.MenuRuleHint: First match from the top wins; otherwise the default pages.
en.Settings.RememberMenuPinNote: Off: every opening starts unpinned. On: the last choice is restored, including after a restart.
en.Settings.RunAsAdmin: Ask for administrator rights at startup
en.Settings.SoundMacro: Cue when a macro is switched
en.Settings.SoundSystem: Cue when the system is switched
en.Settings.ThemeHint: Dark and light are built in; Custom picks one accent.
en.Settings.WheelActionsHint: The global scene holds the defaults. The first program scene whose window rule matches the foreground window wins, and it replaces only the positions it has filled in. Scroll while the wheel is open to switch between merged, global and program actions.
en.Settings.WheelCenterName: Name the aimed action in the centre
en.Settings.WheelExtendedHint: Name the action on the swipe circle in the centre
en.Settings.WheelGestureHint: Hold the button and move the pointer straight away to open the wheel centred on the press, then release over a sector to run it. A short press with no movement stays an ordinary click of that button, so its own menu still opens. Releasing in the centre circle cancels.
en.Settings.WheelGuide: Show the line from the centre to the pointer
en.Settings.WheelMovePointer: Move the pointer to the centre at the screen edge
en.Settings.WheelPreviewHint: Shows the current global actions in the wheel layout. The live wheel still opens on the trigger button above.
en.Settings.WindowRuleRequired: Pick a window and the part of it to match.
en.Speed.Explanation: Scales this macro's waits and pacing by a factor. It applies only while the macro runs, so the steps keep the numbers you wrote; ×1 is exactly as written.
en.Speed.Title: Playback speed
en.Theme.Accent.Hint: The filled button, the selected row and the accent text are all derived from this one color. The accent text is lightened or darkened until it reads against the window, and the button fill is darkened until white text reads on it; both need at least 4.5:1. A color that cannot be made readable is not used, and the built-in accent stays.
en.Theme.Accent.Rejected: This color cannot be made readable, so the built-in accent is used instead.
en.Theme.Base.Hint: Controls such as scroll bars and popups follow this; the accent color is yours.
en.Theme.Palette.Hint: Custom colors are now one accent color; the rest of the interface is derived from it.
en.VarWall.AllHint: Every variable this macro can read.
en.VarWall.Empty: There is nothing in this group yet; try another button above.
en.VarWall.GlobalHint: Created in the Variable Center, and the same for every macro.
en.VarWall.LocalHint: The ones this macro makes for itself: what its steps leave behind, and the ones it declares.
en.VarWall.Pick: Hover over a button to see what that variable is.
en.VarWall.StepResultHint: How each step ended: ok, failed or skipped; no value before a run. The reason is caught.key inside a try.
en.VarWall.SystemHint: Provided by WhaleGenie: the date, the mouse, the clipboard.
en.Wheel.ActionInherited: This position is drawn from the global scene. Saving writes the action here as this program's own; to remove the global action itself, edit the global scene.
en.Wheel.ActionNotePlaceholder: Shown in place of the macro name
en.Wheel.EditorHint: Left click a sector to pick a macro quickly; right click it to edit the macro, note, icon and sub-actions. A program scene replaces only the positions it fills in; everything else comes from the global scene.
en.Wheel.SlotHint: Right click a sector for its action.
en.WindowPart.Title: Title
en.WindowPicker.Filter: Filter by title, program or class
en.WindowPicker.None: No window matches what you typed.
en.WindowPicker.Title: Pick a window
en.WindowRule.BadHandle: A window handle must be a non-zero whole number.
en.WindowRule.CaptureHint: Pick a window on the left, or press “Pick a window” and point at one on the desktop: it is framed as the pointer moves over it, and F1 takes it. Esc cancels.
en.WindowRule.FieldHint: Choose which window or program this step is about, and whether its title, program name or class identifies it; every run finds it again by this rule.
en.WindowRule.HandleHint: This handle identifies only the captured window instance. Re-pick the window after the program is closed or restarted.
en.WindowRule.NoWindows: No windows to choose from right now.

zh.About.SupportText:
WhaleGenie（鲸灵）是完全免费的开源项目。

如果你觉得它对你有帮助，可以通过下方的付款码支持开发者。
zh.Add.Backoff.Jitter: 在半倍到一倍半之间随机
zh.Add.CaptureKeyHint: 单击此处，再按下键盘上的这个键，即填入此处；再次单击取消。组合键请使用「组合键」动作。
zh.Add.ColourPointEmpty: 图案至少要有一处要和基准色一起出现。在加上一处之前，这一步跑不了：那时它找的就只是基准色本身。
zh.Add.Exec.AskWarn: 触发器启动的宏旁边没有人，问出去的问题会一直等下去。无人值守的步骤不要选这一项。
zh.Add.FieldTakesFormula: 此字段可填写表达式；表达式在宏运行时计算。
zh.Add.ImageEmpty: 还没有参考图；列表为空时没有可查找的目标。
zh.Add.NarrowLookHint: 按本行及其上方条件在页面中计一次匹配，并框出这一步将认到的元素。只框不点。
zh.Add.NoActionFound: 目录里没有匹配的动作。
zh.Add.OnError.AskUser: 暂停并询问（重试 / 跳过 / 停止）
zh.Add.OpenKeyPadHint: 在屏幕上摆出来的键盘上点选按键。
zh.Add.PickRegionHint: 在屏幕上拖出一个矩形，自动填入这些字段；按 F1 确认，Esc 取消。
zh.Add.ReturnPickHint: 勾上的各自成为一个变量，悬停结果名看它是什么
zh.Add.SelectHint: 这个窗口还没有动作：关掉它，把动作库里的一张卡片拖到这一步该在的位置。
zh.Add.StepCommentPlaceholder: 显示在步骤下方的备注
zh.Add.StepIdHint: 这一步的名字，写进宏文件。结果变量会带上它，条件用它指这一步。
zh.Add.Title: 添加动作
zh.Add.ValueHint: 给这一格选一个变量，或者用函数把它算出来。
zh.Editor.AddBranchHint: 给这个多分支再加一支，并把这一支的值打开来写。多分支从上往下比对，命中第一支就执行它。
zh.Editor.DeleteSubMacroMessage: 确定删除子宏“{0}”？此操作无法撤销。
zh.Editor.DescriptionPlaceholder: 说明这个可调用宏做什么；从列表中选用时会显示。
zh.Editor.DragActionHint: 单击动作选中，再按「添加步骤」；双击动作会加到步骤列表末尾。要放进块里，点分节标题上的「添加」。
zh.Editor.EmptyBranchList: 还没有分支。用下面的「添加分支」加一支。
zh.Editor.GroupPlaceholder: 可留空；把相关的宏归到一起的名字
zh.Editor.HotstringEndCharsHint: 点亮的字符按钮会结束缩写，再次点击关闭。空格、回车和 Tab 都按字符本身保存。
zh.Editor.HotstringHint: 最多 40 个键盘字面字符；中文输入法提交的文字不属于字串内容。
zh.Editor.IgnoreDelays: 忽略小于以下值的延迟：
zh.Editor.InputLimitHint: 这个宏每秒最多发出多少键鼠事件（KPS）；0 为不限，范围 0–999。
zh.Editor.InterfaceHotkeySupport: 支持字母、数字、F1–F24、方向键、编辑键、小键盘键和修饰键组合。
zh.Editor.ManageGlobalsHint: 新建、编辑或删除这个项目共享的全局变量。
zh.Editor.ManageLocalsHint: 新建、编辑或删除这个宏自己留着的变量；步骤写出来的名字也在这里改名。
zh.Editor.NoDocumentHint: 从「宏」页打开一个宏，或在这里新建一个。
zh.Editor.NoStepsHint: 在左侧动作库选一个动作，再按「添加步骤」。
zh.Editor.NoTriggerSelected: 选择一个入口后可编辑其条件。
zh.Editor.PickActionHint: 先在动作库里选一个动作
zh.Editor.Problem.CannotSave: 宏里还有必须先修正的问题才能保存。
zh.Editor.Project.NotWritten: 已保存到工程；工程包还没有写入磁盘。
zh.Editor.PublicMacroHint: 公共宏没有触发方式。添加后会成为当前宏的子宏，并在根列表留下一个调用。
zh.Editor.RecordEmpty: 这次录制没有捕获到任何操作，通常是录制期间没有产生任何输入。此外，远程桌面、虚拟机或自动化工具发送的输入会被系统标记为程序注入，这类输入会被有意忽略（以免宏把自身的回放再次录入）。若正在远程桌面或虚拟机中操作，请在“录制动作”面板中关闭“忽略其他程序的输入”后重试。
zh.Editor.SpecificHint: 这些只属于这个宏：它自己的输入限制、启用/停用键，以及调用方读到的宏接口。
zh.Editor.StepIdHint: 步骤名称 {0}：结果变量和条件用它指这一步。
zh.Editor.ToggleKeyHint: 按一下停用这个宏，再按一下恢复；这个键本身不发送任何输入，宏停用时它仍然有效。
zh.Editor.UnsavedMessageNamed: 宏“{0}”还有尚未保存的修改。
zh.Editor.UseCursorPosition: 使用光标当前所在位置
zh.Export.Hint: 勾选要写进这个文件的宏。勾中一个宏时，它自己的子宏一并带上；只勾子宏，它会被单独拿出来。
zh.Export.Title: 导出宏
zh.Expr.Op.Group: 用括号把表达式的一部分括起来
zh.ExprBuilder.FunctionsFilter: 按中文名、函数名或写法筛选
zh.GlobalConflict.Hint: 这些名字在文件和本项目里都有。重命名只改随文件带进来的宏，本项目的宏原来读什么还是读什么。
zh.GlobalConflict.Title: 两边都有的全局变量
zh.GlobalVariables.Help: 这些声明由项目里的所有宏共享。修改写进当前文档的草稿，保存文档后才提交进工程。
zh.GlobalVariables.Name: 名字
zh.GlobalVariables.NoVariables: 这个项目还没有全局变量。
zh.GlobalVariables.Persist: 各次运行之间保留这个值
zh.GlobalVariables.Title: 全局变量
zh.HotstringKeyboard.Hint: 点击按键追加字面字符；空格、Tab 和回车按真实字符保存。
zh.HotstringKeyboard.Title: 字串虚拟键盘
zh.Import.Hint: 勾选要带进来的内容。勾一个宏会连它里面写着的子宏一起带上；只勾子宏时，它们进公共宏库，项目要用的时候从库里取一份。
zh.Import.Title: 导入宏
zh.Library.Empty: 公共宏库还是空的。打开一个宏，在宏设置里把它发布到宏库。
zh.Library.Heading: 公共宏库
zh.Library.Intro: 所有项目共用的可调用宏；库里的宏没有触发方式，要用时先在宏编辑器里把它变成子宏。
zh.Library.UseFailed: 把这个公共宏插入编辑器失败。
zh.LocalVariables.Empty: 这个宏还没有自己的变量。用「新建变量」声明一个。
zh.LocalVariables.Hint: 这个宏自己留着用的值，分两种：这里声明的值，新建时给出每次运行开始时用的值；步骤写出来的名字，因为那一步写了它才存在，这里只能改名。改动要点「保存」才生效。
zh.LocalVariables.InitialPlaceholder: 直接填值，或写表达式，例如 count + 1

zh.Main.AboutText:
由 DeepSeek 协助开发。

把键盘、鼠标、屏幕和窗口上的操作编成一步步的宏，用热键、鼠标按键、滚轮，或屏幕上某个像素的颜色触发它。

本程序按 AGPL-3.0 授权，条款原文见程序目录下的 LICENSE.txt，版权署名见同目录的 NOTICE。

zh.Mcp.GrantsNote: 改一下就存下来了：正在运行的 MCP 服务每次调用前都会读一遍，所以下一次调用就按新值来，不用重启客户端，也不用重新复制这段。看屏幕、窗口和控件本来就不需要授权。

zh.Mcp.Title: MCP
zh.Menu.IconSearch: 搜索 Lucide 图标名称

zh.Menu.Unpin: 点击其他窗口时关闭菜单
zh.Palette.Edit: 编辑选中的步骤（F2 或双击）
zh.Palette.Group: 把选中的步骤组合为一个顺序执行的分组 (Ctrl + G)

zh.Palette.Redo: 恢复被撤销的操作 (Ctrl + Y)
zh.Palette.ToggleEnabled: 启用 / 停用选中的步骤 (Ctrl + E)
zh.Run.Title: 运行与调试
zh.Run.TriggersHint: 开着的宏里，靠定时去看的那几种各占一行：等的是什么、现在成不成立、上次去看是什么时候、下次什么时候去看。窗口这一类另有机器在变化时先说一声，不等下一次去看。
zh.Settings.AdminRestart: 以管理员权限重新启动
zh.Settings.AutoSaveProjectNote: 改动会随即写回项目文件。第一次打开会用默认项目；项目还没有文件时，退出前会询问保存位置。
zh.Settings.LoadLastProject: 启动时打开上次的项目
zh.Settings.MenuLauncherHint: 一个键盘快捷键，或鼠标中键、4/5 侧键；滚轮留给翻页。
zh.Settings.MenuRuleHint: 从上往下取第一条命中的规则；都不命中用默认页。
zh.Settings.MenuWindowRulesNote: 前台窗口决定菜单内容
zh.Settings.PreloadOcr: 启动时预加载文字识别
zh.Settings.RememberMenuPinNote: 不勾选：每次打开都从未置顶开始。勾选：恢复上次选择，重启程序后也保留。
zh.Settings.RunAsAdmin: 启动时请求管理员权限
zh.Settings.ThemeHint: 深色与浅色内置；自定义只挑强调色。
zh.Settings.WheelActionsHint: 全局场景放默认动作。前台窗口从上往下匹配，第一条命中的程序场景生效，且只覆盖它填了动作的位置。轮盘弹出后滚动滚轮，可在叠加、只用全局、只用当前程序之间切换。
zh.Settings.WheelCenterName: 在中心显示指向的动作名
zh.Settings.WheelExtendedHint: 在中心显示划圈动作的名字
zh.Settings.WheelGestureHint: 按住该键并立即移动鼠标，轮盘以按下点为中心弹出；在扇区上松开执行。按下后不移动就松开仍是一次普通点击，这个键自己的菜单照常出现；在中心圆松开则取消。
zh.Settings.WheelGuide: 显示从中心到指针的提示线
zh.Settings.WheelMovePointer: 贴边时把指针移到轮盘中心
zh.Settings.WheelOnlyInPrograms: 默认禁用，只在指定软件下唤出
zh.Settings.WheelPreviewHint: 按当前全局动作显示轮盘版面；真正弹出的轮盘仍由上面的触发键打开。
zh.Settings.WheelTitleNote: 按住并移动，指向即执行
zh.Settings.WindowRuleRequired: 请先选择窗口以及要匹配的部分。
zh.Speed.Explanation: 按倍率缩放这个宏的等待与节奏。只在本宏运行时生效，步骤里的数字不会被改动；×1 就是完全按原文运行。
zh.Speed.Title: 运行速度
zh.Theme.Accent.Hint: 实心按钮、选中行与强调文字都由这一个颜色推出来；强调文字会为了在窗口底上读得清而提亮或压暗，按钮底色则压暗到白字读得清，两处都要求至少 4.5:1。推不到这个值的颜色不会被采用，仍用内置强调色。
zh.Theme.Accent.Rejected: 这个颜色怎么调都读不清，已改用内置强调色。
zh.Theme.Base.Hint: 滚动条、弹窗这类控件跟随这个底子；强调色仍由你决定。
zh.Theme.Palette.Hint: 自定义配色已简化为强调色，界面其余颜色都由它推出来。
zh.VarWall.AllHint: 这个宏能读到的一切变量。
zh.VarWall.Empty: 这一类现在还没有变量，点上面别的按钮看看。
zh.VarWall.GlobalHint: 在变量中心创建的全局变量，每个宏看到的都一样。
zh.VarWall.LocalHint: 这个宏自己留着的变量：它的步骤留下来的那些，以及它声明的那些。
zh.VarWall.Pick: 鼠标停在按钮上就能看见那个变量是什么。
zh.VarWall.StepResultHint: 每一步跑完的状态（ok / failed / skipped）；运行之前没有值。失败原因在 try 的 caught.key 里。
zh.VarWall.SystemHint: 由鲸灵提供、随时取用的值：日期、鼠标位置、剪贴板这些。
zh.Wheel.ActionInherited: 这个位置当前沿用全局场景的动作，保存后会写成本程序自己的动作；要清除全局动作本身，请到全局场景里改。
zh.Wheel.ActionNotePlaceholder: 显示在扇区上，代替宏名
zh.Wheel.EditorHint: 左键点扇区快速选宏；右键点扇区可编辑宏、备注、图标与子动作。程序场景只覆盖自己填了动作的位置，其余位置沿用全局场景。
zh.WindowPart.Title: 标题
zh.WindowPicker.Filter: 按标题、程序或类名筛选
zh.WindowPicker.Title: 拾取窗口
zh.WindowRule.BadHandle: 窗口句柄必须是不为 0 的整数。
zh.WindowRule.CaptureHint: 在左边挑一个窗口，或者按「取窗口」到桌面上指一扇：指针移到哪扇窗口，它就被框出来，按 F1 确认。Esc 取消。
zh.WindowRule.FieldHint: 选这一步说的是哪个窗口或程序，以及用标题、进程名还是窗口类认出它。每次运行都按这条规则重新找。
zh.WindowRule.HandleHint: 句柄只认拾取到的这个窗口实例；目标程序关闭或重开后要重新拾取。
